caption: The drawing depicts a single handbag prominently positioned in the center of the image. The handbag features a textured, brown surface designed to resemble crocodile skin, with variations in shading to represent the texture. The handle is a matching brown, attached to the bag with two metal rings on either side. The top edge of the bag is framed with a metallic-looking clasp and hinges, depicted in grey. On the lower right portion of the bag’s front, there is a silver metallic ornament shaped somewhat like an irregular loop or stylized letter "A". The outline of a flap is visible, forming a V-shape across the upper front section of the bag. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a secondary, light pencil sketch showing the same bag in a partially open position, revealing its internal structure and compartments. The background of the drawing is a plain, beige color.
title: Child's Handbag
